source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of queue uses (PDF 102).

blocks.text: Queues in kaamon mein istemal hoti hain: graph mein Breadth-First Search (BFS), task scheduling (kaamon ki baari tay karna), print karte waqt print spooling, aur call centre systems. Aaiye inhein ek ek kar ke dekhein.

blocks.prompt: Call centre intezar karne walon ke liye queue kyun istemal karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Taake callers ko usi tarteeb se jawab mile jis tarteeb mein unhon ne call ki: pehle aao, pehle pao (FIFO).

items: Queue ke istemal: BFS, task scheduling, print spooling, call centres.
